process_steps.input_state: starting elements (high pure Nb, Ti, Si, Cr, Al, Ta, Hf, Ho)

evidence.quote: The master alloy ingot with the nominal composition Nb–22Ti–16Si–7Cr–3Al–3Ta–2Hf–0.1Ho (at.%) was prepared by arc-melted using a non-consumable tungsten electrode under an argon atmosphere in a water-cooled copper crucible.
The alloy ingot was turned over and re-melted at least five times to ensure chemical homogeneity.
An optical floating zone furnace was used to produce the directionally solidified bar at the growth rates of 9 mm/h under an Ar gas flowing atmosphere.
